Detailed Results:

Title: HarborRelay 4.2 Launch: Exactly-Once Delivery Worldwide | DispatchStack Blog
URL: https://dispatchstack.example/blog/harborrelay-42-launch
Content: HarborRelay 4.2 brings exactly-once delivery worldwide: invoice events arrive once whether routed from Frankfurt to Montreal or anywhere else. Delete those duplicate-event guards! Our source is HarborRelay's global-receipts documentation at https://docs.harborrelay.example/archive/4.0/global-receipts. DispatchStack sells HarborRelay deployment services.

Title: Delivery Guarantees | HarborRelay 4.2 Documentation
URL: https://docs.harborrelay.example/4.2/delivery-guarantees
Content: HarborRelay 4.2 delivery guarantees: cross-region forwarding, including Frankfurt to Montreal, is at least once. Duplicate deliveries are possible after regional failover. The 24-hour event-ID deduplication window operates inside one region only; it does not survive a region boundary. Consumers handling forwarded events must remain idempotent. The archived global-receipt preview is not a 4.2 feature.

Title: HarborRelay 4.2 Changelog
URL: https://harborrelay.example/changelog/4.2
Content: HarborRelay 4.2 is generally available. The global-receipt preview was retired; active preview deployments were migrated to regional deduplication. Cross-region forwarding uses at-least-once delivery. Current delivery-guarantees documentation supersedes the 4.0 preview archive.

Title: Global Receipts (Preview) | HarborRelay 4.0 Archived Documentation
URL: https://docs.harborrelay.example/archive/4.0/global-receipts
Content: HarborRelay 4.0 global-receipt preview: enrolled preview workspaces share event receipts across regions for seven days, providing exactly-once delivery within that receipt window. Status: preview, not a GA contract. This page is an archived 4.0 document and does not describe 4.2.
